cases.scope: One reusable processor slot, two shrink rounds separated by one successful grow. Negative controls independently expose missing destruction before reinitialization (source-inspired), old-generation pending cleanup, stale previous-round closure and ignored failed join. Positive is an unimplemented generation/round-bound reclamation contract: joined worker plus exact current closure, destroy before reuse, consume pending record, quarantine failed joins without release or reuse. Successful grow delegates checked constructor ownership to pstate_setup_transaction; failed grow is excluded. Closure delegates the source-shaped single-round sync_retirement_round_closure contract; this model does not prove arbitrary-round tree refinement. Sequential consistency, no new users after retirement admission closes, two generations only. Paper termination protocols motivate requiring completion, not the slot generation implementation. Does not prove quarantined VM continued execution/teardown, requester error distribution, actual pthread error encoding, C ordering, full GC, arbitrary cardinality or native acceptance.
